id: title:CShine612:apply step renames made outside the rename modal

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the construction of funnel step labels and custom names in the frontend query result, potentially affecting the displayed name and custom name for actions and events in the funnel visualization.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F3.H5 demonstrates a substantive, bounded change: replacing a flat map with a block-scoped object, adding `rawLabel` extraction, custom name resolution, and a fallback chain for the `name` field. This is a correctness and reliability improvement for the funnel visualization. Other hunks are either tests or truncated, so the score relies solely on P1.F3.H5.

This limits confidence in the completeness of the implementation and its associated tests, though P1.F3.H5 alone establishes a clear, bounded change.
